title: Mega Man: Dual Override Game's Trailer Reveals Twinkle Girl, Protoman
content: CAPCOM unveiled a new trailer during this year's gamescom Opening Night Live event on Tuesday for Mega Man: Dual Override , a new game in its Mega Man series, and it introduces the new character Twinkle Girl as well as returning character Protoman.
author: ANN

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword Game's New Trailer Previews Action
content: CAPCOM revealed a new trailer for its Onimusha: Way of the Sword game during the pre-show for this year's gamescom Opening Night Live event on Tuesday, previewing the swordplay action. A playable demo is available now.
author: ANN

title: Sound Editor R.J. Kizer Dies at 73
content: The family of sound editor Robert James Kizer (known professionally as R.J. Kizer ) revealed on Sunday that he died on August 12 after a battle with glioblastoma. He was 73. The family does not plan to hold a funeral, but are planning for a memorial.
author: ANN

title: Sōhei Niikawa's Demons' Night Fever Game Reveals Opening Movie Performed by syudou
content: Arc System Works began streaming on Monday the opening movie for Disgaea creator Sōhei Niikawa and SuperNiche's new game Demons' Night Fever . syudou performs the opening theme song "Dropout." The game will debut on October 22 for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam .
author: ANN

title: New Battle Spirits TV Anime Reveals Main Trailer, Additional Cast, Theme Song Artists, October 6 Premiere
content: The official website for Battle Spirits [Re] Zekkai no Kū , a new television anime series in Bandai's Battle Spirits multimedia franchise , revealed on Tuesday the main trailer, visual, additional cast, and October 6 premiere. The trailer previews the opening theme song "Here we are!" by JAM Project .

title: The Simpsons x Black Mirror Crossover First Look Trailer Reveals New Disney+ Special – Watch
content: The Simpsons is coming back to Disney+ this week with a brand new exclusive special, and the first look trailer reveals a cool crossover inspired by Black Mirror . The Simpsons Season 37 wrapped up its run with Fox earlier this year , and with it ended up having much fewer episodes than seen in past seasons.
